name: Clear picker search on every close path
description: The repo and branch pickers now clear their search filter whenever the popover closes, regardless of how it was dismissed.

steps.title: Repo switcher: reset on close
steps.body: Previously the filter was cleared inside `onOpenChange`, which bits-ui only fires for interaction-driven closes (Escape / outside-click) — not when `pick()` or a context-menu/dialog action sets `open` directly. An `$effect` keyed on `open` covers every close path: refresh dirty markers on open, clear the filter on close.

steps.title: Branch picker: reset on close
steps.body: Same root cause. The existing `reset()` (filter + active tab + PR-fetch tracking) is now driven by an `$effect` on `open` instead of `onOpenChange`, so it runs when you check out a branch, open a PR, or use a context-menu action.
